newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai T-bill repo rates, spots end mostly down.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai T-bill repo rates, spots end mostly down.

text.p: Contracts on the treasury bill repurchase market in Shanghai closed mostly down on Tuesday with money demand on the market sharply decreasing with prices on the stock markets plunging, tradres said.
The most active seven-day contract ended down to 7.97 percent from 9.00 percent on Monday.
Total turnover fell sharply to 3.21 million lots from 8.67 million. One lot is 1,000 yuan face value of treasury bills.
Both domestic A share and foreign currency B share indices in Shanghai and Shenzhen plunged on Tuesday on rumours about the health of Chinese leader Deng Xiaoping.
